head.title: VoxLab — Free PC Voice Studio

meta.content: VoxLab is a free, local voice studio for PC. Clone voices, generate speech in English and Bengali, all on your own computer. No account, no subscription.
meta.name: description

div.h1:
Clone, generate
and create — on your own PC.
div.p: VoxLab is a free voice studio that runs entirely on your computer. No account, no subscription, no cloud. Download once, generate forever — in English and Bengali.
Windows PC • Open models only • Your audio stays on your machine
Give VoxLab a short sample, and it learns that voice. Then type any text and hear it back in that voice — for narration, videos, learning material and stories.
Drop in a WAV or MP3 you own or have permission to use. Cloning starts from a few seconds of clean audio.
Record straight in the app, check the waveform, and clone that take. Planned, not in v1 yet.
Clone a voice from audio playing on your PC. Planned, not in v1 yet.
Everything is built around one idea: the person who downloads VoxLab runs it on their own PC, with their own models, at zero running cost.
Chatterbox, the audit winner in VoxLab testing, clones a voice from a reference clip.
Kokoro gives ready-made voices instantly — type and generate, no sample needed.
Parler Bengali speakers (Arjun, Aditi, Tapan, Rashmi, Arnav, Riya) plus Edge Bengali presets, in an ElevenLabs-style filter. No ElevenLabs voice is copied.
Listen in the app, download MP3, and reuse the audio in your own projects.
Speak and get text in any app, with Whisper transcription running locally. Planned, not in v1 yet.
Give a voice a character, then Rewrite a line in character or let it Compose a fresh line. Planned, not in v1 yet.
Pick the right model for the job. All models are open, downloaded once, and run locally. No API keys, no rate limits, no per-character fees.

div.p: Missing vs the reference app, honestly listed above: dictation in-app, system-audio capture, microphone recording, voice personalities (Rewrite / Compose), multi-voice stories, audio effects, and an MCP / agent voice endpoint. Those are the roadmap, not v1 claims.
VoxLab already serves generation on your own machine at a local address, so your own scripts and tools can call it. No key, no limit, no fee — and your audio never leaves your PC.
Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Free, open-source, local. No account, no API keys, no per-character fees.
Apple Silicon (ARM) — coming after the Windows v1 release
Intel (x64) — coming after the Windows v1 release
64-bit (MSI) — coming with the v1 release, the main VoxLab download for PC
Build from source — coming after the Windows v1 release
The app is free. Forever. Everything that makes VoxLab great runs locally at no cost. Pay only if you want optional, encrypted cloud backup & sync.
The full app, free forever. No account required.
Voice cloning across every TTS engine, dictation & capture, MCP / personalities, unlimited local generations, 100% open source, runs entirely on your machine.

Backup & sync for everything you make. Launch price.
Everything in Local, end-to-end encrypted backup, sync across desktop & mobile, 25 GB encrypted storage, up to 5 devices, 30-day version history.

Everything in Cloud, 250 GB encrypted storage, unlimited devices, 1-year version history, priority support.
Cloud and Studio are coming soon and are not for sale yet — no payment is taken for them on this site. Cloud pricing and limits are not final and will be confirmed at launch.
